Method of Attack: Phishing campaign leveraging trusted SharePoint servers to host malicious PDFs containing phishing links.
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with links to SharePoint-hosted PDFs
Indicators of Compromise: Links leading to SharePoint documents containing further malicious links
Mismatched file types (e.g., OneNote mentioned but PDF shown)
Requests for urgent action or expiring documents
Links leading to third-party sites unrelated to SharePoint
